cc:Work.dc:description: A 384-dimensional query is divided into twelve segments of 32 and stacked as heads 0 through 11. Tensor shape changes from 1 by 7 by 384 to 1 by 12 by 7 by 32. Merging reverses the reshape; an output projection follows attention.
